title: Maximum Students on a Single Bench
summary: Given a 2D integer array of student data, where each entry is [student_id, bench_id], return the highest count of unique students on any single bench.
statement: Given a 2D integer array of student data, where each entry is [student_id, bench_id], return the highest count of unique students on any single bench. If no students are present, return 0. Each student on a bench is counted only once.
constraints: Count a student only once per bench even if the same record repeats.
Return the largest unique-student count on one bench, or zero for no records.
hints: Map every bench to a set of student IDs.
Set insertion automatically removes repeated records on the same bench.
An empty mapping uses the required default of zero.
editorial: An empty mapping uses the required default of zero.

tests.explanation: Bench three has three distinct students, the maximum.
No bench has a student, so return zero.
